name: PACLitaxel (single-agent taxane, later-line anal SCC)

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.histology: squamous cell carcinoma of the anus
biomarkers.note: Single-agent weekly paclitaxel is a reasonable later-line cytotoxic for previously treated metastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma when a taxane has not been used, chosen for tolerability. No molecular biomarker gate for selection. General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: Corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling (hypersensitivity prophylaxis).

supportiveCare: PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle (weekly taxane), continued until progression or intolerance.
Assess peripheral neuropathy each cycle; hold/reduce for grade 2+ neuropathy.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3-4 neutropenia or grade 2+ peripheral neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and reduce paclitaxel per labeling; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle (weekly taxane). Requires corticosteroid + H1/H2 antihistamine premedication. ISMP tall-man: PACLitaxel (distinguish from DOCEtaxel). General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.
